_note: The party (docs/05-combat.md, docs/future/F08). Everyone shares one level and one pool of experience: each entry in `levels` has the total `xp` needed to reach it. Each member has a stat line for every level. `resources` holds what each class spends: its name on screen, and what it gets back for an Attack, at the start of a round after the first, and as a share of its most after a win. A resource can also say `onHit`, what each damaging hit brings back, and `startsAt`, the share of its most every fight starts with in place of what was carried in. `fallenBack` is the share of their most health someone down at the end of a won fight gets back. `signature` is the move a full Ward gauge gives. `combos` are what a member's own hits set off: a hit of element `by` on a foe under status `on` (results are in rules.ts). `pointsPerLevel` is the upgrade points each level earns each member (ranks are in skills.json). `typicalFoeRes` is the foe the Upgrades page's rough damage figures assume. Icon names are drawn icons in src/ui/icons.ts.

defeat.line: Eldwin is too worn to go on.
defeat.hint: Spells can be swapped at a hearth, and a group he sees coming can be walked around.
